# DumbBrew — Full Site Content

> This is the full-content companion to llms.txt (https://dumbbrew.com/llms.txt), per the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/). It inlines each public page's actual content so an LLM doesn't need to fetch every page separately. Content shown here reflects the site's checked-in fallback defaults; live prices, menu items, brews, and tutorials are stored in Supabase and may differ — treat this file as a good-enough snapshot, not the live source of truth. All prices are in Indian Rupees (₹).

## Home — https://dumbbrew.com/index.html

DumbBrew's home page. Links out to every section below (Brews, Menu, Story, Gallery, Shop, Tutorials, Visit). Includes a seasonal/upcoming-events section and an email newsletter signup.

## Brews — https://dumbbrew.com/brews.html

The core brew lineup:

- **The Regular** (Drip, ₹3.50) — Our house blend, drip-brewed and honest. No tasting notes, no ceremony — just coffee that gets the day open.
- **Slow Cortado** (Espresso, ₹4.50) — Equal parts espresso and steamed milk, pulled to order and served in warm glass. Four sips of quiet.
- **Overnight Cold Brew** (Cold Brew, ₹4.75) — Eighteen hours of patience in a steel tank. Round, low-acid, smooth enough to drink black.

## Brew Methods (Gallery) — https://dumbbrew.com/gallery.html

"However you like it" — eight ways to brew the same bean:

- **Pour Over** — A slow, hand-poured drip through a paper filter for a clean, bright cup that shows off a bean's character.
- **Espresso** — Nine bars of pressure through finely-ground coffee in under 30 seconds. The base for everything else on the board.
- **Chemex** — A thick filter and an hourglass carafe for a lighter, tea-like body.
- **French Press** — Full immersion, no filter paper, more body and oils in the cup. Four minutes, then press.
- **Aeropress** — Immersion plus pressure in one small plunger — fast, portable, forgiving of a rough grind.
- **Moka Pot** — Stovetop pressure brewing, dense and syrupy — the closest thing to espresso without the machine.
- **Turkish Coffee** — Finely ground coffee simmered directly in water, unfiltered, served with the grounds settled at the bottom.
- **Siphon** — Vapor pressure pulls water up through the grounds and back down through a filter — theatrical, and genuinely cleaner-tasting.

## Our Story — https://dumbbrew.com/story.html

"We started with a bad pun and a good roaster." DumbBrew opened in 2019 because the neighborhood needed a place that took its coffee seriously and everything else a little less so. Every bean is roasted in small batches just down the street, and every loaf comes out of the oven before sunrise. "No corporate syrups. No ten-word drink names. Just good coffee and terrible dad jokes on the chalkboard."

Milestones:
- **2019 — Doors open**: A single espresso machine, a secondhand roaster, and a chalkboard full of bad puns.
- **2021 — The oven arrives**: Bread and pastry moved in-house — croissants before sunrise, every day since.
- **2023 — Roastery down the street**: Small-batch roasting moved two doors down so the beans never travel far.
- **2026 — Still terrible at naming things**: Menu's bigger, jokes are worse, coffee's better.

## Shop — https://dumbbrew.com/shop.html

The commerce storefront: DumbBrew's own catalog plus every onboarded local seller's products, in one grid. Add to cart, then checkout via https://dumbbrew.com/cart.html (Razorpay, INR). Sellers are a standalone identity (not customer accounts) — see "Partner With Us" below for how a seller gets listed here.

## Tutorials — https://dumbbrew.com/tutorials.html

Admin-written recipe and brewing how-to articles — a Medium-style article per tutorial, each with a title, category, excerpt, optional embedded video (YouTube/Vimeo, or a direct video file), and a rich-text body with inline images. Individual articles are served at `https://dumbbrew.com/tutorial.html?slug=<slug>`. This list is dynamic (stored in Supabase's `tutorials` table, public read of published rows only) — fetch `/tutorials.html` directly or query Supabase for the current set rather than relying on a fixed list here.

## Partner With Us / Become a Seller — https://dumbbrew.com/seller-apply.html

Public application form — no DumbBrew account needed. An admin reviews the application; on approval, a seller account (standalone login, separate from customer accounts) is generated and the seller can manage their own catalog and orders from a seller dashboard.
